thread:
maia: Quick check — I paired with @chris and @devon this morning on the v2 response-shape deprecations. We sketched owners for three lanes: SDK marshaling, proxy shim, and docs. Can folks confirm ownership?

chris: I can own the proxy shim + routing fallback. Will open PR with a feature flag. Target canary Wed.

devon: I’ll take SDK marshaling. Plan is a non-breaking deserializer that honors `X-Compat-Mode` so apps can opt into v1 behavior for a week. Will send PR today.

sasha: I’ll own docs + migration checklist. Will add examples and a short changelog entry. ETA Fri COB.

maia: thanks. Quick question @devon — do we need a server-side header or query param for the SDK change? You mentioned `X-Compat-Mode: v1` earlier.

devon: yes header approach. Example we’ll add to SDK README: 
```
fetch('/v2/generate', {
  headers: { 'X-Compat-Mode': 'v1' }
})
```
Server/edge will route based on that header.

maia: @chris can the proxy accept that header and route to the v1 shim without requiring token changes or new scopes?

chris: yep — proxy will pass-through token and map path+header -> shim actor. No scope changes. I’ll add unit + integration tests. Canary routing will start at 5%.

maia: sounds good. Also need to decide on an opt-out window and deprecation timeline for v1 endpoints. Suggest: 30 days of overlap after rolling to 100%, then deprec notice. Any objections?

devon: 30 days seems fine. SDK will emit a console.warn when `X-Compat-Mode` is not present to nudge devs.

sasha: I’ll include the timeline in the migration guide and a migration checklist for customers (update SDK, verify tests, flip header, monitor).

canary-bot: Canary deployed: 5% traffic -> proxy-shim (sha: abc123). Metrics: +3ms p50, errors 0.5% -> investigating slow deserialization in one client.

devon: noted — I’ll add a tiny optimization to the marshaler and push a patch.

chris: pushed proxy PR draft: rfc link + test matrix in description. @maia can you add approvals when ready?

maia: will review today. Also scheduling a cross-team sync Thu 10am PT to walk owners through the checklist and failover plan.

sasha: added calendar invite.

maia: final owner list for the record: devon (SDK marshaling), chris (proxy shim & routing), sasha (docs/migrations). Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:

devon: dropping PR link and changelog in this thread when ready.

canary-bot: Canary stable after 24h: no new regressions, promoting to 25% traffic.
